policies.note: In-scope uncovered — PE-US computes the ACA premium tax credit (IRC 36B); no PE-backed PTC comparison suite runs yet.

Lapsed before the 2026 validation year: the Affordable Connectivity Program (47 USC 1752; IIJA 2021 sec. 60502) stopped new enrollments 2024-02-07 and paid its last partial benefit for May 2024 as appropriated funds were exhausted. PolicyEngine-US 1.767.3 zeroes gov.fcc.acp.amount for 2026, so acp pays 0 for every synthetic case even with is_acp_eligible forced on and broadband_cost 2400 (probe evidence: scripts/probe_us_repealed_federal.py). Axiom encodes current law and has no current-law ACP surface to compare.
